sources.scope: Product listing documents the 75-mg tablet. It does not verify local stock or a dosing protocol.
Use, oral loading versus maintenance, bleeding, premature discontinuation, CYP2C19 activation and the PPI differences, including 12-hour omeprazole separation.

sources.section: 2025 multisociety ACS guideline, antiplatelet therapy and bleeding reduction
sources.scope: DAPT after ACS/PCI and PPI use when GI bleeding risk warrants it. Clopidogrel choice and DAPT duration depend on the clinical setting and prescriber.

facts.sourceExcerpt: Prodrug whose active metabolite irreversibly inhibits platelet P2Y12 receptors.
facts.rationale: Differentiate indirect irreversible P2Y12 inhibition from aspirin, direct reversible P2Y12 inhibition, and GP IIb/IIIa blockade.
Apply continuation of ordered oral therapy following a documented one-time load. No IV preparation is in scope.

facts.sourceExcerpt: loading doses are separate physician/protocol orders.
facts.rationale: Distinguish the one-time loading order from oral maintenance.

facts.sourceExcerpt: Routine maintenance needs no special preparation
facts.rationale: Shared oral medication preparation is not a distinct objective.

facts.sourceExcerpt: Commonly part of dual antiplatelet therapy after ACS/PCI and coronary stenting.
facts.rationale: Choose the complementary antiplatelet for DAPT after ACS and PCI.
Recognize possible significant GI bleeding and prioritize urgent evaluation in a recent stent recipient.
Recognize access-site bruising and declining hemoglobin as possible additive bleeding during combined treatment.

facts.sourceExcerpt: Clarify unexpected omissions after recent coronary stenting promptly because premature interruption raises thrombotic risk.
facts.rationale: Identify the time-sensitive risk of stent thrombosis despite the patient being asymptomatic and on aspirin.

facts.sourceExcerpt: Avoid coadministration with omeprazole or esomeprazole. Separating omeprazole by 12 hours does not prevent the interaction. Pantoprazole has less effect
facts.rationale: Select the less-interacting PPI and reject omeprazole separation and esomeprazole substitution.

facts.sourceExcerpt: Clopidogrel requires metabolic activation, in part by CYP2C19. Omeprazole and esomeprazole can inhibit this step.
facts.rationale: Explain the interaction through reduced CYP2C19-mediated prodrug activation.

facts.sourceExcerpt: Interrupting therapy after stenting can raise the risk of thrombosis.
facts.rationale: Identify risk specific to interruption following a recent stent.

facts.sourceExcerpt: YES. Palestinian essential-medicine and registry data document 75-mg tablets. ED shelf/drawer label photographed, 2 Nov 2026. This is a named compartment, not an independently audited stock count; check the package before use.
facts.rationale: Formulary, registry and local shelf-label provenance, not proof of current package supply.

facts.sourceExcerpt: Bleeding; avoid casual interruption after recent coronary stenting.
facts.rationale: Duplicates bleeding and stent omission objectives.
